title: Build, test and audit
summary: tools/build_rexxsql.sh copies the pristine source, applies the patches with patch (or git apply), configures for ooRexx and SQLite with no extra options on Ubuntu 24.04, and builds librexxsql.so. run_tests.sh builds, then runs the driver test (52 checks), the backend-contract test (24) and the store's live suites; it passes from a zipfile extraction, as autobuild runs it. RexxSqlPlanAuditSession records every statement whose SQLite plan scans a whole table: use it before adding indexes.
invariants: Scripts are run through sh, so the loss of execute bits in ZIP extraction does not matter.
The build fails loudly if configure did not select the ooRexx 4.0+ API.
Audited sessions double the calls per statement: diagnostics only.
